name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: No M7+ quake in seven days; largest M6.4 near Easter Island
state: USGS recorded five earthquakes of M6 or above in the seven days to 2 Nov; the largest was an M6.4 south-east of Easter Island on 29 Oct, and an M6.0 struck near Vanuatu on 1 Nov. There was no M7+ event, no PAGER orange or red alert and no tsunami warning.
for_you: No damaging earthquake affecting populated areas this week.
rubric_hit: Max M6.4 < M7 Watch line; PAGER green
why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
